about_the_game:
League of Foes is a Multiplayer Local Battle Arena (MLBA)

Inspired by classic MOBA mechanics, League of Foes brings friends together in heated split-screen couch competition, offering accessible yet strategic gameplay that anyone can jump into and enjoy. Matches are fast-paced, averaging 5-10 minutes, perfect for quick gaming sessions.

Choose from eight unique characters, each representing distinct archetypes. Destroy crystal towers alongside your minions, strategically push lanes, and battle your way to destroy the enemy's server. Explore the Deep Woods in the center of the map, where special minions and Nitro Tomes await.

Gather your friends, select your hero, and prepare for fast-paced battles where every decision matters!

Key Features:

  • Local Split-Screen Action: Face off in intense battles with your friends.

  • Steam Remote Play: Only 1 friend needs to own the game for up to 4 players to join!

  • Eight Unique Heroes: Master heroes with distinctive abilities and playstyles, each offering fresh tactics and team synergies.

  • Strategic Gameplay: Capture lanes, summon minions, and destroy enemy crystal towers to ultimately crush your opponent’s server.

  • Explore the Deep Woods: Battle neutral monsters and secure powerful Nitro-Tomes to turn the tide of the match.

  • Multiple Game Modes: Play 1v1 or 2v2 matches, team up with friends in Co-op vs bots, or hone your skills solo against AI opponents.

League of Foes combines accessible gameplay with strategic combat, perfect for gamers seeking competitive fun with friends.
